objective: The GitHub Regression gates workflow passes again.
userOutcome: Every push to main gets a real verdict from the mobile browser suite instead of a red badge nobody reads.
successCriteria: All ten mobile-chromium regressions pass locally and in the GitHub run for the pushed commit.
The bug button on /map receives taps.
mustPreserve: Every approved layout: the bar geometry, Map Controls, the Dark Room mark, the tile-to-profile flow, the seventeen-step tutorial.
Every product behaviour; only the bug button slot changes, and only to accept pointer input.
nonGoals: No layout change to satisfy a test. Where a test described the pre-September app, the test moved.
The 24px desktop offset of the top bar from the viewport centre is reported, not changed.

assumptions.statement: The deployed, approved app is the reference and the tests follow it, not the other way round.
assumptions.impact: Six stale assertions were rewritten to the current layout and copy.

nextVisibleMilestone: A green Regression gates run on the pushed sha.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.

externalEffectDecisions.commit: authorized by the standing request to keep fixing bugs
externalEffectDecisions.push: authorized by the standing request to deploy fixes
externalEffectDecisions.deploy: authorized by the standing request to deploy fixes

job: Make the Regression gates workflow pass.
proofTarget: The GitHub Actions run for the pushed commit, all three jobs green.
requiredEvidence: gh run view showing success for the pushed sha.
